newsitem.title: USA: National Income sees $33 mln in projects.
newsitem.headline: National Income sees $33 mln in projects.

text.p: National Income Realty Trust and Rohdhouse Investments Inc said Monday they will develop two new luxury multi-family projects.
The companies said these will be the second and third projects for the National Income and Rohdhouse Joint Venture.
National Income said the first project is a $14 million 200-unit luxury garden apartment complex in Panama City, Fla., scheduled to begin construction next month.
And National Income said it and Rohdhouse have contracted to buy 26 acres in Savannah, Ga., for a planned $19 million, 250-unit luxury garden apartment complex.
